metadata.description: Rehearsal manifest for a marketplace migration. Not for installation.

plugins.name: rent-check
plugins.description: Every always-loaded line pays rent or gets cut. /rent-check audits CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules dirs and the always-loaded surface around them: load-class costing, enforcement-backing analysis (which rules are just words), reality drift against the live repo, and evidence-tiered verdicts with folklore labeled as folklore — report-first, verified draft diffs, never auto-applied.

rows: ⚡ **Your CLAUDE.md bills you every turn** · most context files carry lines that earn nothing
🔬 **Evidence-tiered verdicts, folklore labeled** · KEEP/FIX/PROMOTE/DEMOTE/MERGE/CUT with citations — and which of your rules are just words
🛡️ **Report-first, edit-never** · verified draft diffs land as inputs to your decision; a mandatory counter-finding keeps it honest
card.run: Then run `/rent-check` in your busiest repo
